resolution: Made the loader-pane edit loop coherent and added the rotate verb. Problem: the live overlay (req_1798) can ADD meshes but can't ERASE a baked one, so deleting/moving/rotating a piece already in the baked gamefile left the old mesh lingering until an unrelated bake. Fix is a two-tier model: placements and edits to this-session (unbaked) pieces stay INSTANT via the overlay; when an edit drops a BAKED piece id (detected in LoaderIsoView's live-push effect — a previously-baked id is gone from the piece set), it calls a debounced requestSettleBake (~1.2s, wired in index.tsx) so the baked geometry folds the change in and the lingering mesh clears on reload. Pure placements keep every baked id present, so they never bake — the common path stays instant. Also added rotate: R turns the selection 90° (whole buildings as one buildingMoved+yaw, loose pieces via remove+place, the same shape IsoAuthor uses) or the placement ghost when nothing is selected. TSX-only, hot-reloads, bundle clean. Live test is the user's. Flagged future optimization: a host-side hide-baked-instances door would make baked-piece delete/move instant too.
